for a project you cannot see.\n- [Delete a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused wi
th 409 while goals still reference this persona — deleting it would strand them.\n- [Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/swarms/update-a-persona.md): Partial update. Goals reference the persona by id, so renaming one does not disturb anythi
ng pointing at it.\n- [Draft personas with a model](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md):
Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing. That separation is deliberate: generation is the step most likely to produce something nobody
wanted, and a route that both invented and saved would make \"let me see what you'd suggest\" indistinguishable from \"fill my pr
oject with these\".\n- [Draft journeys for a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md
): Returns DRAFTS and persists nothing — see `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` for why, and for the quota this counts
against.\n- [Get a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-journey.md)\n- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mc
pjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-journey.md): ARCHIVES rather than deletes, and the response says so. Existing runs keep po
inting at the definition they executed, so their history stays readable.\n- [Update a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/swarms/update-a-journey.md): Editing a goal never disturbs a run already under way: a run pins its own immutable snapshot of th
e definition at launch.\n- [List swarms](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-swarms.md)\n- [Create a swarm](https://
docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring container holding DEFAULTS for the goals made und
er it. Creating one starts nothing.\n- [Get a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-swarm.md)\n- [Archive a sw
arm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the container. The goals authored under it are not
touched — they keep their own definitions and stay launchable.\n- [Update a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/u
pdate-a-swarm.md): Changes the container's DEFAULTS. Goals already authored under it keep the values they were created with — this
is not a cascade.\n- [List journeys](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-journeys.md): The project's goals, newest
first. Archived goals are excluded.\n- [Create a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creat
es one goal: a persona pursuing a task against one or more environments. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/
{projectId}/goals/generate` — that route persists nothing.\n- [List secrets](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/list-se
crets.md): The project's credentials as METADATA ONLY — no value is returned by this or any other route. Shows the project-shared
secrets plus the caller's own personal ones; another member's personal secret does not appear at all, not even its name.\n- [Creat
e a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/create-a-secret.md): Store a credential so environments can grant it to
runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever makes the call. The response is metadata only. Creatin
g a project-shared secret requires project admin; a personal one does not.\n- [Get a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/secrets/get-a-secret.md): One secret's metadata: delivery mode, host binding, sharing, and when it was last handed to a run. Neve
r its value. A secret from another project — and another member's personal secret — both read as 404.\n- [Delete a secret](https:/
/docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/delete-a-secret.md): Delete a stored credential. HARD — the row and the encrypted value bot
h go, and MCPJam stops delivering it. Deliberately NOT blocked when an environment still selects it: refusing would leave a leaked
credential undeletable until someone edited every environment naming it, and deletion must never wa…\n- [Rotate or re-bind a secr
et](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/rotate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the value and/or change how it is deliver
ed. A rotation reaches NEW RUNS ONLY: a session already running holds the old value — materialized in its box's environment, or in
side an egress policy that cannot be read back — and there is no safe way to replace it mid-run.\n- [List a journey's runs](https:
//docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-journeys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact records — `attempts` is on the single-r
un read.\n- [Launch a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journey.md): Answers **202**: the run row
exists and its fan-out has started. It is not finished — poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-runs/{runId}` until `status` leaves
`running`.\n- [Get a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journey-run.md): The full record, includ
ing per-session `attempts` and `targetSummaries`.\n- [List a run's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list
-a-runs-sessions.md): One entry per chat session the run produced. Summaries, not transcripts — read a transcript through the chat
-session routes using `id`.\n- [Cancel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): A
ccepts a durable Stop request and returns immediately. cleanupPending indicates that attempts are being settled in the background;
status remains the current stored run status. IDEMPOTENT: cancelling an already-cancelled run answers 200 with `alreadyCanceled:
true` and `finalized: 0`, not a 409.\n- [Project swarm roll-up](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/project-swarm
-roll-up.md): Recent runs with their goal-completion rates and repeat-failure findings, plus a project-wide trend. Deterministic a
nd free — start here.\n- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-sco
recard.md): The deterministic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.\n- [List swarm findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-
reference/swarm-insights/list-swarm-findings.md): Criteria that keep failing, tracked across waves. One finding is one problem OVE
R TIME — `occurrenceCount` and `status` carry the history, so do not treat repeat appearances as separate problems.\n- [Dismiss a
finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/dismiss-a-finding.md): Hides a finding from your view. ORTHOGONAL to
`status`: dismissing does not claim the problem stopped happening, and a dismissed finding that fires again stays `recurring`.\n-
[Undismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/undismiss-a-finding.md): Reverses a dismissal. Bodyles
s, like its twin.\n- [Get swarm run insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-swarm-run-insights.md): Pol
l this after requesting insights. **404 means nobody asked** — it is deliberately not an empty `status: \"none\"` body, so a calle
r in a polling loop cannot mistake \"never requested\" for \"asked and still working\".\n- [Request swarm run insights](https://do
cs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/request-swarm-run-insights.md): Answers **202**: generation is scheduled, not done. Pol
l the GET above rather than re-requesting.\n- [Cancel a pending swarm-run-insights generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/swarm-insights/cancel-a-pending-swarm-run-insights-generation.md): Stops a generation that is still `pending`. A swarm run with
no generation in progress answers 409 — there is nothing to cancel, and reporting success would tell a caller it stopped somethin
g it did not.\n- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude
-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with
a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or
a cost. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…\n- [Start an OpenAI plugin-directory readiness run](https:
